Independent full prefix-mask census, orbit check, and pairwise witness check
correctness.rationale: For n>=6 the three-letter endpoint blocks are disjoint, and every cross-prefix/suffix comparison is decided by these blocks, including self-pairs. For the observed prefix set P, the suffix set lies in the full compatible set S(P), so the code is contained in P times the free middle words times S(P). Conversely the full product is admissible. The independent chunked subset-OR census exhausts every one of the 134217728 prefix masks, obtaining product 72 for exactly 42 masks with (prefix size,suffix size) multiplicities (6,12):6, (8,9):15, (9,8):15 and (12,6):6. A maximum code must use the full product; S(P) is nonempty and its code recovers P as the set of actual prefixes, so there are exactly 42 labelled maximum codes at every n>=6. Permuting symbols and reversing words acts on the saturated pairs as stated; an independent check finds disjoint representative orbits of sizes 12,12,12,6 whose union is all 42 maximizing pairs. The proposed size-72 witness passes all 15552 ordered pair/overlap-length comparisons at n=6. The valid reason for that witness is that every forbidden-length prefix starts with 0 and every forbidden-length suffix starts with 1 or 2; different first and last symbols alone would only exclude length one. Replay with python3 /workspace/branches/58b5f690-3f98-400f-a95a-e5adec20c352/census.py (NumPy); equality_pairs.txt in the same directory contains the equality pairs. The finite calculation proves the base problem, and factorization proves the all-length statement.
residual_risks: The witness justification in the frozen text is abbreviated as noted; the choice of suffixes, not merely a difference of initial and terminal symbols, is necessary for that justification. The proof of the extremal census is computational.

value.rationale: The first short-overlap parameter beyond the exact k=2 result gives a natural ternary base capacity problem. The prior construction provides a concrete extremal candidate and the inspected general bounds are looser; the unrestricted upper bound closes that gap. A complete equality classification distinguishes inequivalent optimal constructions that the size alone could not identify, and applies at every length of the factorization, rather than just to a single small codebook.
residual_risks: The outside-parameter cases and a non-enumerative proof of the upper bound are not supplied.
